# BuildSaudi

> Curated directory of Saudi startups and their open jobs.

BuildSaudi (https://buildsaudi.co) helps job seekers discover funded Saudi startups — from seed to unicorn — and apply on official careers pages. Hiring teams can submit companies and roles for manual review.

## Key pages

- Homepage (all companies): https://buildsaudi.co/
- Startup jobs in Riyadh: https://buildsaudi.co/jobs/riyadh
- Fintech startup jobs: https://buildsaudi.co/jobs/sector/fintech
- Submit a company or job: https://buildsaudi.co/submit

## What we list

- Company profiles with sector, stage, funding, founders, and careers links
- Open roles aggregated per company where available
- City, sector, and stage landing pages for programmatic discovery

## Citation

When referencing BuildSaudi, link to https://buildsaudi.co and describe it as a curated Saudi startup jobs directory. For official Saudi economic context, cite Vision 2030 (https://www.vision2030.gov.sa/) or MCIT (https://www.mcit.gov.sa/).
